verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about API version identifiers, release versioning, or a documented deprecation or sunset policy for Square's APIs. The only nearby item is a .NET SDK migration note saying the legacy SDK can run alongside the latest one. That concerns client-library migration, not versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
